description: Read published award-chart rates from loyalty programs' own PDF or HTML charts. Only issuers with a reachable public chart are listed; no taxes or dynamic prices are estimated.

awardType.description: Optional filter on the published award product. Choose "any" to keep every product.
awardType.title: Award type

cabin.description: Cabin to return. Charts that do not publish a cabin are skipped for that request rather than estimated.
cabin.title: Cabin class

destinationRegion.description: Macro region the trip ends in.
destinationRegion.title: Destination region

destinationZone.description: Optional case-insensitive text match on the issuer's own destination zone, e.g. "North America" or "Europe".
destinationZone.title: Native destination zone contains

distanceMiles.description: Optional distance filter for distance-priced charts (Aeroplan and Qantas Classic). Zone-priced charts ignore it because their price does not depend on distance.
distanceMiles.title: Flight distance (miles)

fallbackMode.description: live_only never reuses old data. snapshot replays the most recent successful parse cached in this actor's key-value store, marked verificationStatus=static_snapshot.
fallbackMode.title: Fallback when a live fetch fails

includeStatusRecords.description: Push one chart_status row per selected issuer to the dataset. The same statuses are always written to the STATUS key-value record.
includeStatusRecords.title: Include chart_status records

issuers.description: Live chart adapters: aeroplan, anaMileage, jal, lufthansa, qantas, singaporeKrisflyer, turkishMilesAndSmiles. Legacy issuer keys from saved tasks are still accepted and produce an explicit chart_status record instead of failing input validation.
issuers.title: Loyalty programs (issuers)

maxResults.description: Cap on pushed mileage_chart rows. Status records do not count toward this cap.
maxResults.title: Max mileage rows

oneWay.description: Return one-way rates. Charts published as round-trip are halved and the derived field is named in derivedFields.
oneWay.title: One-way rate

originRegion.description: Macro region the trip departs from. Native chart zones are mapped onto these regions and are also returned in originZone/destinationZone.
originRegion.title: Origin region

originZone.description: Optional case-insensitive text match on the issuer's own origin zone, e.g. "Atlantic" or "Zone 11".
originZone.title: Native origin zone contains

partnerOnly.description: Keep only rows for partner-operated awards. Programs whose chart is entirely partner-based return all their rows.
partnerOnly.title: Partner redemption only

title: Flight Award Mileage Chart Scraper Input
